query:
INSERT INTO sessions (
                subject,
                grp,
                starts_at,
                duration_min,
                classroom,
                source,
                created_by,
                created_by_email,
                is_overridden,
                scraped_at
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'manual', $6, (SELECT email FROM users WHERE id = $6), false, NULL)
            RETURNING
                id,
                subject,
                grp,
                starts_at,
                duration_min,
                classroom,
                source AS "source: SessionSource",
                created_by,
                is_overridden
